pages.name: Solve it
pages.why: Take 2x off both sides, leaving 2x + 6 = 16. Then 16 − 6 = 10 and 10 ÷ 2 = 5. As a check, both sides make 26.

pages.name: Drag them off
pages.task: 4x + 1 = x + 13. Drag boxes off the pans until x is on one side only, keeping it level.
pages.why: Each box is the same x, so one off each pan keeps it level. The right pan had only one, leaving 3x + 1 = 13. Then 13 − 1 = 12 and 12 ÷ 3 = 4, and both sides make 17.

pages.name: x on the right
pages.text: In x + 7 = 3x + 1 the left pan has only one x, so take one x off each pan. Then take 1 off each, leaving 6 = 2x, so x = 3.
